cadence.citation: docs/alarm-lane-design-20260922.md section 2.3; the confirmation rule is T8a 5.5
derivation: the confirmation rule needs 2 consecutive element sets, so a confirmable change becomes visible about 0.987 d after it happens (2 x 0.493 d)
re-reading more often than one median spacing re-reads unchanged element sets, so the work floor is 0.493 d
against a median causal lead of 195.9 d, one work floor of latency is 0.3% of the warning budget
the host timer's own period of 2.0 h is 0.0% of the same budget and buys nothing, because the element sets it would re-read have not changed
so: fire on the host timer, and do work only when the object's newest element-set epoch has advanced
